description:
Get live prediction-market odds for a real-world event, phrased as a natural
    language question. Call this when the user asks about the probability, odds, or
    likelihood of any future event (elections, sports results, crypto prices, Fed
    decisions, geopolitics). Example: "will France win the World Cup".
    Returns the best-matching market with implied probabilities and source links. For which venue fills the SAME contract cheaper, use list_executable_opportunities (all matched pairs) or compare_executable_quotes (one pair) instead.

question.description: Natural-language question about a future event, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in December?'
question.title: Question

name: get_market_odds
title: Prediction-market odds for an event
